description: Source code for the PHY driver for ADIN2111 Ethernet PHY in Zephyr RTOS, including register definitions, initialization, IRQ handling, and configuration functions.

methods.name: phy_adin2111_c22_read
methods.description: Reads a 16-bit register via MDIO Clause 22.

methods.name: phy_adin2111_c22_write
methods.description: Writes a 16-bit register via MDIO Clause 22.

methods.name: phy_adin2111_c45_read
methods.description: Reads a register via MDIO Clause 45.

methods.name: phy_adin2111_c45_write
methods.description: Writes a register via MDIO Clause 45.

methods.name: phy_adin2111_reg_read
methods.description: Reads a 32-bit register from the PHY.

methods.name: phy_adin2111_reg_write
methods.description: Writes a 32-bit register to the PHY.

methods.name: phy_adin2111_await_phy
methods.description: Waits for the PHY to come out of reset.

methods.name: phy_adin2111_an_state_read
methods.description: Reads the auto-negotiation state and link status.

methods.name: phy_adin2111_sft_pd
methods.description: Enters or exits software power-down mode.
